findings.body: After a successful clear, `clear.isSuccess` remains true while this component stays mounted. If the admin then removes a member on the same page, a new block exists, but the page still says people can rejoin. Clear the success message when a later removal succeeds so it does not describe the current state incorrectly.
findings.title: Clear-success message stays visible after a new removal

findings.body: This new review-status record is outside the permitted paths and does not implement removal or blocked-invite behavior. The previously reported scope gap remains in the supplied diff.
findings.title: Simpler: drop task-status record → keep the scoped web change
